title: GEF CLI governed state document
description: Persisted state artifact written by a guided gef init --apply / gef adopt --apply run. Emitted by the CLI after a kernel transaction promotes the artifact; consumers must fail closed on an unsupported schemaVersion major.

schemaVersion.description: Explicit document schema version. A consumer that does not support the major version must fail closed.

observationFingerprint.description: Versioned fingerprint of project state recorded at apply time. V1.1.0 documents without observationModel used the full diagnostic observation; PROJECT_DRIFT_V1 excludes only GEF-managed root metadata directories.

observationModel.description: Explicit semantics of observationFingerprint. Absent only in compatible V1.1.0 state documents.
